## Goal
- Fix P0 production defects in IVX IA Chat (circular spinners, slow streaming, narrative responses, repeated authorization, autonomous coder blocked) and deploy live to GitHub owner control with verified QA.

## Constraints & Preferences
- Owner explicitly said "Rork not create swift app stay focus" — no new app creation, stay on IVX platform only
- No narratives, no certifications until code works live
- No fabricated logs, commits, SHAs, deploy IDs, or test results
- GitHub `ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform` is canonical source of truth
- Render deploys from GitHub main automatically
- Must remove all circular spinners from normal chat, fix streaming UX, fix senior-dev response style, persist owner authorization, add automatic recovery, remove invented progress percentages

## Progress
### Done
- Fixed 2 pre-existing TypeScript errors in `backend/api/ivx-owner-passwordless-login.ts` (preconnect type cast, removed invalid `createUser` option from GenerateLinkOptions)
- Installed missing `ai` and `@ai-sdk/openai` packages (were causing 2 autonomous test failures)
- Removed `RefreshControl` `controlRoomQuery.isFetching` from chat (was showing spinner during background refetch) in `expo/app/ivx/chat.tsx`
- Replaced animated typing pill with static text "IVX is responding…" in `expo/app/ivx/chat.tsx` — after 12s with no delta, shows "Still processing…" static text. No circular spinners.
- Removed `ActivityIndicator` import and usage from `expo/src/modules/ivx-owner-ai/components/ExecutionConsoleBubble.tsx` — replaced with static "(live)" text
- Removed `ShimmerIndicator` from `expo/components/IVXAdvancedExecutionMode.tsx` — replaced with plain text loading state
- Removed invented progress percentages from ExecutionConsoleBubble — replaced progress bar with stage label only
- Fixed senior-engineer persona in `backend/services/ivx-senior-engineer-persona.ts` — removed "CURRENT STATE / BUSINESS IMPACT / RECOMMENDED NEXT ACTION" template, added concise engineering response style rules, added owner authorization persistence rules
- Created `backend/services/ivx-owner-authorization-store.ts` — new module for persisting owner authorization by task ID + owner ID + scope fingerprint (24h TTL)
- Wired authorization persistence into `backend/services/ivx-chat-autonomous-handoff.ts` — same task scope does not re-ask for approval
- Added automatic recovery for transient failures in `backend/services/ivx-senior-developer-worker.ts` catch block — detects HTTP 403/429, rate limit, timeout, network errors; bounded retries (max 3) with exponential backoff; owner authorization preserved across retries
- Backend TypeScript compiles clean (`bunx tsc --noEmit` exit 0)
- Committed as `a1cdeb072` on branch `v1109-p0-fixes`, cherry-picked onto `github/main`
- Pushed to GitHub main → `8bc73d8d1` (v1.10.9, versionCode 107)
- Render deployed `8bc73d8d1` — verified healthy at `https://api.ivxholding.com/health`
- SHA parity achieved: GitHub = Render = `8bc73d8d1f864a3362a59fba776bfbc99e647f0a`
- APK build started in background (`./gradlew assembleQa --build-cache`), JS bundle completed (3934 modules, 34s), build still running

### In Progress
- APK build `assembleQa` running in background (PID 35914/35962) — JS bundle done, Gradle packaging in progress
- Live QA tests not yet executed (waiting for APK + backend verification)

### Blocked
- Android real-device QA: no physical device, no KVM, no stable emulator
- iOS / TestFlight QA: no device or TestFlight access
- GitHub Actions CI: infrastructure failures (steps=0), separate from code issues

## Key Decisions
- Cherry-picked P0 fix commit onto fresh branch from `github/main` to resolve non-fast-forward rejection
- Replaced animated typing pill with static text instead of hiding behind another state — owner mandate was to REMOVE spinners, not hide them
- Authorization persistence uses in-memory store with scope fingerprint hashing (24h TTL) — simple, process-lifetime, no external dependency
- Automatic recovery uses pattern matching on error messages to classify transient vs permanent failures

## Next Steps
1. Wait for APK build to complete, upload to Supabase storage
2. Run live QA tests: TEST 1 (Spanish chat "¿Cuál es tu nombre?"), TEST 2 (technical question), TEST 3 (real dev task "Fix the IVX chat loading behavior end to end"), TEST 4 (recovery)
3. Instrument TTFT (time to first visible token) with production timestamps T0-T8
4. Verify no spinners in production chat, no repeated authorization prompts, concise senior-dev responses
5. Report final results in the owner's exact output format

## Critical Context
- GitHub main SHA: `8bc73d8d1f864a3362a59fba776bfbc99e647f0a` (v1.10.9)
- Render production SHA: `8bc73d8d1f864a3362a59fba776bfbc99e647f0a` (healthy, boot 2026-08-10T02:35:10)
- Git remote was changed from Rork router to `https://github.com/ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform.git` (Rork independence migration completed earlier)
- `.rork/` is in `.gitignore` and not shipped to GitHub
- Rork independence audit: 7 pass, 0 failure — no `@rork-ai/*`, no `withRorkMetro`, no `rork.json`, no Rork URLs in Expo app code
- Certificate file exists at `qa/IVX_CERTIFICATION_2026-08-08.md` but is NOT on GitHub main (certificate commit `533eba70` was superseded by Rork suspension commits)
- Prior to this session, 4 "Failed: Account rork is suspended" commits were on top of the certificate commit
- The owner observed real production defects despite prior QA reports claiming fixes were done

## Relevant Files
- `expo/app/ivx/chat.tsx`: Main chat screen — removed RefreshControl spinner, replaced animated pill with static text, added 12s pill expiry
- `expo/src/modules/ivx-owner-ai/components/ExecutionConsoleBubble.tsx`: Removed ActivityIndicator, removed progress bar, replaced with stage label
- `expo/components/IVXAdvancedExecutionMode.tsx`: Removed ShimmerIndicator loading spinner
- `backend/services/ivx-senior-engineer-persona.ts`: Fixed system prompt — removed narrative templates, added concise engineering response rules, added authorization persistence rules
- `backend/services/ivx-owner-authorization-store.ts`: NEW — authorization persistence store (task ID + owner ID + scope fingerprint)
- `backend/services/ivx-chat-autonomous-handoff.ts`: Wired authorization persistence into chat handoff
- `backend/services/ivx-senior-developer-worker.ts`: Added automatic recovery for transient failures in catch block
- `backend/api/ivx-owner-passwordless-login.ts`: Fixed 2 pre-existing TypeScript errors
- `expo/app.config.ts`: Bumped version to 1.10.9, versionCode 107
